title: Parameter indicate a passed string parameter to a service template with an optional default value

default.title:
Default is the default value to use for an input parameter if a value was not supplied
DEPRECATED: This field is not used

globalName.title:
GlobalName exports an output parameter to the global scope, making it available as
'{{io.argoproj.workflow.v1alpha1.outputs.parameters.XXXX}} and in workflow.status.outputs.parameters

value.title:
Value is the literal value to use for the parameter.
If specified in the context of an input parameter, the value takes precedence over any passed values

valueFrom.title: ValueFrom describes a location in which to obtain the value to a parameter

default.title: Default specifies a value to be used if retrieving the value from the specified source fails

jqFilter.title: JQFilter expression against the resource object in resource templates

jsonPath.title: JSONPath of a resource to retrieve an output parameter value from in resource templates

parameter.title:
Parameter reference to a step or dag task in which to retrieve an output parameter value from
(e.g. '{{steps.mystep.outputs.myparam}}')

path.title: Path in the container to retrieve an output parameter value from in container templates
